headline: Glacy or Leafy
title: Pranky | Glacy or Leafy Evolution Choice | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pranky is a Water healer that splits into two forms, and you only get one choice per Pranky. Skippy becomes Pranky at level twelve. At level twenty, Pranky can turn into Glacy with a Wave Stone. Or it can become Leafy, but you must defeat the Alpha Leafy first and use a Sprout Stone. Want both? Raise two Prankys. Which branch are you picking? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Pranky evolves from Skippy at level 12. At level 20 it becomes Glacy with a Wave Stone, or Leafy after defeating the Alpha Leafy and using a Sprout Stone. Each Pranky takes only one branch.
